units: 1 Blender unit = 1 metre; models face +Z with Y up after the FBX axis conversion (-Y forward, Z up on export)

budgetExemptions.Env_Grass_Blade: single blade for dense scatter -- 10 tris is the point

windVertexColors.R: sway mask, 0 at the trunk base rising to 1 at the leaf tips
windVertexColors.G: phase offset, randomised per leaf cluster
windVertexColors.B: high-frequency flutter mask (leaves and blades only)
windVertexColors.appliesTo: every asset in the Foliage family
windVertexColors.encoding: Exported with colors_type=LINEAR, so the FBX carries the authored 0-1 mask values VERBATIM -- no gamma encode is applied on the way out. Measured: authoring (0.25, 0.50, 0.75) writes (0.25, 0.50, 0.75) to the file. Blender's own importer then decodes them as sRGB and shows (0.051, 0.216, 0.521), which is an artefact of that importer, not of the data. If Unity turns out to apply the same decode, either undo it in the shader with pow(c, 1/2.2) or flip envlib.export_fbx to colors_type='SRGB' and re-run build_all.py -- the choice is one line.

unitySetup.normals: Import (custom split normals are authored; do not recalculate)
unitySetup.materials: One material per family atlas is enough: assign the family BaseColor + Normal to the shared stylised toon shader. Every mesh in a family is UV-packed into that one atlas.
unitySetup.lodGroups: For any asset with a non-empty `lods` array, add a LODGroup with LOD0 = base mesh, LOD1 and LOD2 from the listed FBXs. Suggested screen-relative heights 0.45 / 0.16 / 0.03 with 30% fade transition width, Cross Fade animation mode.
unitySetup.characterRig: Animation Type = Humanoid, Avatar Definition = Create From This Model on Env_Char_Player.fbx, then Copy From Other Avatar for the three NPCs (identical skeleton). Import the @Clip FBXs with Avatar Definition = Copy From Other Avatar.
unitySetup.colliders: None authored. Cliff, path and riverbank modules are closed solids suitable for mesh colliders; foliage should use no collider or a capsule.
